Short description: Preparation and filing of income tax returns for individuals, HUFs, firms and companies.
Detailed description (one per line):
We prepare and file income tax returns after reviewing income from all sources, available deductions and tax already paid through TDS, TCS or advance tax.
Before filing, we reconcile your information with Form 26AS and the Annual Information Statement (AIS) to reduce the chance of mismatches and notices later.
Who it is for (one per line):
Salaried individuals
Professionals and freelancers
Business owners
NRIs with Indian income
Partnership firms and companies
Scope of work (one per line):
Collection and review of income and investment documents
Reconciliation with Form 26AS / AIS / TIS
Computation of total income and tax liability
Filing of the return and e-verification support
Follow-up on refunds and processing intimations
What the client receives (one per line):
Computation of income
Filed ITR and acknowledgement
Summary of tax position for the year

Short description: Lawful planning of tax affairs, regime selection and advice on specific transactions.
Detailed description (one per line):
We review your income, investments and expected transactions to help you plan your tax position within the law, including the choice between the old and new tax regimes where relevant.
For significant transactions such as property sales, ESOPs or business restructuring, we provide a written note on tax implications before you proceed.
Who it is for (one per line):
Individuals with multiple income sources
Senior executives with ESOPs
Business owners
Scope of work (one per line):
Review of current tax position
Regime comparison
Transaction-specific tax analysis
Advance tax estimation
What the client receives (one per line):
Written tax planning note
Advance tax schedule

Short description: Responding to notices, scrutiny assessments and appeals before tax authorities.
Detailed description (one per line):
We examine the notice, identify what is being asked and why, and prepare a documented response within the time allowed.
Where required, we represent clients in assessment proceedings and assist with appeals.
Who it is for (one per line):
Individuals and businesses who have received a notice
Taxpayers under scrutiny assessment
Scope of work (one per line):
Analysis of the notice
Preparation of submissions and supporting documents
Online responses and hearings
Rectification and appeal assistance
What the client receives (one per line):
Written response filed with the department
Status updates through closure

Businesses and employers
Firms and companies with withholding obligations

Short description: GST registration, monthly/quarterly returns and annual returns.
Detailed description (one per line):
We handle GST registration and the full cycle of periodic returns, including reconciliation of input tax credit with GSTR-2B before each filing.
For annual compliance, we prepare GSTR-9 and, where applicable, the GSTR-9C reconciliation statement.
Who it is for (one per line):
New and existing businesses
E-commerce sellers
Service providers
Traders and manufacturers
Scope of work (one per line):
GST registration and amendments
GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B filing
ITC reconciliation with GSTR-2B
Annual return (GSTR-9 / 9C)
LUT filing for exporters
What the client receives (one per line):
GST registration certificate
Filed returns and payment challans
Monthly reconciliation report
